mapper.sql: select template_id, template_key, template_name, prompt_content, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_prompt_template
mapper.select: and template_key like concat('%', #{templateKey}, '%')and template_name like concat('%', #{templateName}, '%')and status = #{status} order by template_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_prompt_template(template_key, template_name, prompt_content, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{templateKey}, #{templateName}, #{promptContent}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update ai_prompt_template set template_key=#{templateKey}, template_name=#{templateName}, prompt_content=#{promptContent}, status=#{status}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate(), remark=#{remark} where template_id=#{templateId}
mapper.delete: delete from ai_prompt_template where template_id in #{templateId}
